_comment: The only place that decides which MTProto server this client talks to. Edit this file, then run: python3 Tellomi/generate_server_config.py. See docs/TELLOMI.md. Active seeds are api.tellomi.cn, TCP port 10443, datacenter 1. That name is DNS-only and currently points at 8.137.39.82 (seed_address_a_record). The development RSA key is Teamgram's (gnetway.yaml KeyFingerprint 12240908862933197005). Dev login SMS code is 12345. seed_address_a_record and local_docker_seed are not dialed. For Teamgram docker on the same machine, put 127.0.0.1 in seeds instead (the iOS Simulator reaches the host there) and regenerate the header. A SOCKS proxy still needs an IP literal: its request encodes the destination with inet_aton. Do not commit a private key.
